other: Legacy ran under GnuCOBOL 3.1.2 + the C/SQLite CICS/DB2/VSAM stub runtime (legacy/), not on z/OS CICS/DB2/VSAM. Parity is against that harness (107/107 baseline transcripts replay with no golden fixtures).

The migrated side is driven through a parity-only test seam (parity/tools/ParityServer.java: /__parity reset, EIBTASKN restart, exec, dump); all business beans are the unmodified target/classes. ABNDPROC/record uses the property-gated, token-protected POST/GET /banking/admin/abend, enabled only on the parity server (disabled by default).

BANKDATA (batch) is not replayed per flow: its output is the canonical seed, and the seeded CUSTOMER/ACCOUNT/PROCTRAN/CONTROL dumps of both sides were verified identical before every flow on both databases.

3270 screen flows (BNKMENU/BNK1*) have no REST surface: they run in-process through the com.ibm.cics.cip.bank.core.screens handlers (parity/tools/ScreenParity.java). Screen fields and table dumps are compared; RETURN COMMAREA bytes are not (Java keeps a symbolic state map).

React UI in Chromium covers the read paths (customer by number, accounts of a customer, name search, account by number) on both databases. Create/update/delete screens were not driven in the browser in this round; their REST calls are covered by the API flows and by the React axios contract tests. (PR #26 reported a browser CRUD run on PostgreSQL; not re-observed here.)
Pre-existing UI quirk (production React source, unchanged): CustomerDetailsPage Submit toggles table visibility, so a consecutive search needs a second Submit.

PostgreSQL: flows run serially, one fresh schema per parity server (DROP/CREATE before start); concurrency on PostgreSQL is covered only by the opt-in PostgresProfileMainFlowsTest (concurrent counter allocation).
Comparison normalisation: CHAR right-trim, numbers to 2dp, row order. Nothing else is masked; PROCTRAN_REF and every other column is compared.

harness_findings: First PostgreSQL run: CREACC/max-accounts and CREACC/ninth-account ended in ERROR before comparison because the harness translated their SQLite setup_sql (recursive CTE) to H2-only SYSTEM_RANGE; the migrated service correctly returned 500 for that statement. Fixed in parity/tools/parity.py (sqlite_to_migrated: generate_series on PostgreSQL). Both flows MATCH on PostgreSQL after the fix. Harness defect, not a migration defect.

PostgreSQL folds the unquoted legacy column names of the in-process 3270 dumps to lower case; parity/tools/ScreenParity.java upper-cases dump keys so the CUSTOMER/ACCOUNT/PROCTRAN/CONTROL dumps compare column by column.

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: Abend time HH:MM:MM - the ABND-TIME STRING concatenates WS-TIME-NOW-GRP-MM twice instead of minutes then seconds. Present in 23 programs (all BNK1*, BNKMENU, CRDTAGY1-5, CREACC, CRECUST, DBCRFUN, DELACC, DELCUS, INQACC, INQACCCU, INQCUST, XFRFUN). Found by reading the source; no recorded flow reaches those abend paths.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: DBCRFUN ignores the overdraft limit - a payment-interface debit (COMM-FACILTYPE = 496) fails with code 3 whenever available balance + amount < 0, even inside the overdraft (DBCRFUN/within-overdraft: balance 0, limit 500, debit 400 -> refused).
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: Teller debits have no funds check - with any FACILTYPE other than 496 a debit can drive any account negative (DBCRFUN/insufficient-funds-teller, BNK1CRA/debit-insufficient).
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: LOAN/MORTGAGE - only payment-interface requests are refused (fail code 4); teller credits/debits are applied (DBCRFUN/loan-teller).
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: Zero amount - DBCRFUN with amount 0.00 succeeds and still writes a PROCTRAN row.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: XFRFUN has no funds check - XFRFUN/insufficient-funds succeeds and leaves the from-account negative; the same applies to BNK1TFN.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: XFRFUN same account abends the task with SAME instead of returning a fail code.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: XFRFUN to-account not found returns fail code 2 after two SYNCPOINT ROLLBACKs.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: UPDACC does not validate the account type - CHEQUE is written (UPDACC/invalid-type); only a blank type is rejected. Balances in the COMMAREA are ignored.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: UPDCUST only updates name/address; DOB and credit score in the COMMAREA are ignored. A blank name keeps the old name.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: BNK1DCS non-numeric customer number - BIF DEEDIT turns ABC into 0000000000, which INQCUST treats as "random customer", so the screen shows a random customer with "Customer lookup successful.".
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: BNK1CAC overdraft length underflow - SUBTRACT <trailing blanks> FROM OVERDRL assumes the field is transmitted with its trailing blanks. If a terminal sends a short field (e.g. 0 with L=1) OVERDRL goes negative and INSPECT OVERDRI(1:OVERDRL) is an invalid reference modification (GnuCOBOL runtime crash; undefined on z/OS without SSRANGE). Screen transcripts therefore send fields blank-padded to their full width, as a 3270 does for a field pre-filled with blanks.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: BANKDATA account data - with 1,30,1,42 it creates no MORTGAGE accounts; LAST/NEXT statement dates are fixed literals; CURRENT overdraft limit is always 100.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: no flow exercises it directly (BANKDATA output = canonical seed, verified identical before every flow)

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: CRECUST review date and BANKDATA use FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE (the real system clock), not CICS time - the only wall-clock dependency in the estate; the harness pins it via COB_CURRENT_DATE.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: Credit scores depend on the CICS task number (RANDOM(EIBTASKN)), so on a real region two identical requests get different scores.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: Typo in DELCUS abend free-form text: "Unbale to DELETE CUSTOMER VSAM rec".
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: not exercised: no transcript forces the DELCUS VSAM-delete failure that writes this abend text

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: INQACCCU returns success with 0 accounts for an existing customer without accounts, but fail code 1 for a non-existent customer.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: CREACC rejects lower-case types (isa, fail code A); the 10th account is refused with fail code 8 (> 9 accounts check), the 9th is allowed.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

pre_existing_legacy_defects.text: INQCUST custno 0 ("random customer") always returns customer 0000000001 under the harness, whatever CBSA_RANDOM_SEED (GnuCOBOL -std=ibm COMPUTE truncation of RANDOM(EIBTASKN)); BNK1DCS non-numeric input inherits it.
pre_existing_legacy_defects.parity: every flow exercising it is identical (legacy behaviour reproduced) on H2 and PostgreSQL

flows.resolution: PR #27: AbendFile (ABNDFILE port) + property-gated, token-protected POST/GET /banking/admin/abend; response and ABNDFILE contents compared.

flows.root_cause: POST /banking/account had no opening-balance fields: COBOL CREACC writes COMM-AVAIL-BAL/COMM-ACT-BAL (50, 100, -5000, -125000) while the migrated account opened at 0.00.
